reviews.name: IcingOnTheRing
reviews.text:
I hired Innovative Outdoor Lighting for a landscape lighting project at my Palm Desert home and had a great experience from start to finish. Sabrina, the owner, was extremely responsive and easy to communicate with when scheduling and planning the project. When she came out to the property, she took the time to carefully walk through both the front and back yard and thoughtfully plan where each light should go to create the best overall look.

Her installation team was professional, polite, and respectful of the property. They worked efficiently and left the entire job site spotless when they finished.

One thing that really stood out was Sabrina’s willingness to go above and beyond. She included smart lighting controls, which are normally an upgrade, at no additional cost, and even added an extra light after the installation without charging for it.

Overall, a very positive experience and I would absolutely recommend Innovative Outdoor Lighting to anyone looking to improve their outdoor lighting.

reviews.name: Greg J.
reviews.text: I am thrilled with my new landscape lighting from Innovative Outdoor Lighting and Audio. We’ve gone from worst to first in the neighborhood. Sabrina was easy to deal with and the price was very reasonable.

reviews.name: Josh L.
reviews.text: Sabrina and team really stick the landing - from bidding and design to installation I was so glad to have gone with IO Lighting. Clean work, no baby sitting - just great results. If I ever need lighting, home theater sound, or holiday lighting I am definitely going to give these folks a call.

reviews.name: Bill S.
reviews.text: I love my house even more. The lights look great. Thank you thank you. I love the new lights. Sabriena, It was great working with you. You made the place look great. I love it!

reviews.name: Harry F.
reviews.text:
Sabrina and her worker David did a great job replacing the lights in our backyard! From beginning to end the communication was good and every concern was addressed. Our backyard now lights up so beautifully at night!
If you’re looking for an outdoor lighting company, I highly recommend them!
